hero.title: Your clean, offline productivity haven.
hero.subtitle: Manage projects, tasks, docs, and files — entirely on your machine. No cloud. No subscription.

appPreview.title: Built for real work.
appPreview.subtitle: Dark and light mode. Compact, focused interface. Your workspace, your way.

features.title: Everything you need. Nothing you don't.

items.title: Private & Local Workspaces
items.description: Work solo in a Private Workspace or open your workspace to your local network (LAN).

items.title: Network Auto-Discovery
items.description: Automatically discover active Local Workspaces on your Wi-Fi or LAN via UDP Broadcast without needing to share IP addresses.

items.title: Real-Time Collaboration
items.description: Changes to projects, tasks, and documents sync instantly to all connected team members via SignalR.

items.title: Projects & Tasks
items.description: Organize your work into distinct projects, track status, priority, and link tasks.

items.title: Docs
items.description: A clean document editor to take notes and draft ideas.

items.title: Files
items.description: Securely import and organize reference files locally within your workspace.

items.title: Member Management
items.description: Accept or reject join requests directly from the app. Monitor who is online.

items.title: Dark/Light Mode
items.description: Full support for system-integrated dark and light themes.

items.title: Local-First Architecture
items.description: Your data never leaves your machine. Everything is stored locally via SQLite.

items.title: Automatic Backups
items.description: Daily automatic backups of your database to ensure data safety.

whyFlowDesk.title: Why FlowDesk over Notion or Linear?
whyFlowDesk.subtitle: Most tools send your data to their servers. FlowDesk keeps everything on your machine — and still gives you the features you actually use.

cta.title: Ready to take back your data?
cta.subtitle: Download FlowDesk today and experience true local-first productivity.
